Property/bodyScripts/Description
details.newValue: Insert here your Hotjar/Google Analytics scripts to be inserted at body of the page.

details.name: Property/headerScripts/Description
details.newValue: Insert here your Hotjar/Google Analytics scripts to be inserted at header of the page.

details.name: Property/searchConsoleVerification/Description
details.newValue:
When set the ID will be placed in a meta tag in the head for Google Search Console Verification: 
<meta name="google-site-verification" content="your verification string">

details.name: Property/cookiePage/Description
details.newValue: Select the cookies page to change preferences

details.name: Property/umbracoError404/Description
details.newValue: Set page to be shown on 404 errors

details.name: Property/umbracoError500/Description
details.newValue: Set page to be shown on 500 error

details.name: Property/redirectsFile/Description
details.newValue: Upload an Excel file here with the first column with Old urls, and second column with the new urls to redirect to.

details.name: Property/doNotFollow/Description
details.newValue: Setting to true will prevent search engines from following the links on the page, so it will not index the pages it finds (only) on this page.

details.name: Property/doNotIndex/Description
details.newValue: Setting to true will prevent a page from appearing in Google Search by including a noindex meta tag in the page's HTML code. This will also exclude the page from the sitemap.

details.name: Property/searchKeywords/Description
details.newValue: Use this field to add specific search keys that can be used ONLY in the search of the site. Separate your keywords by comma.

details.name: Property/seoMetaDescription/Description
details.newValue:
Meta Descriptions are commonly used in search engine result pages, and are extremely important in gaining user click-through. Make sure to let users know whether the page contains the information they're looking for. It is recommended to keep it between 50 and 160 characters.

See also: https://moz.com/learn/seo/meta-description

details.name: Property/seoMetaTitle/Description
details.newValue:
The title should be an accurate and concise description of a page's content, and is critical to both a user experience and search engine optimization. It is recommended to keep it under 60 characters.

See also: https://moz.com/learn/seo/title-tag

details.name: Property/umbracoUrlAlias/Description
details.newValue: This property allow us to provide multiple URLs for a page. The values that we type has to be lowercase and we have not to use a leading or trailing slash.

details.name: Property/umbracoUrlName/Description
details.newValue: Umbraco generates the URL name of a page from the Page name that we have defined. If we want to define a different name we can use this property to set a new URL name for the page.

details.name: Property/websiteName/Description
details.newValue: If filled in, the website name will be added to the end of the page title

details.name: Property/socialLinks/Description
details.newValue: Supported platforms: Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Youtube and LinkedIn

details.name: Property/ogDescription/Description
details.newValue: To overrule the description property for social sharing

details.name: Property/ogImage/Description
details.newValue: The image for sharing on social media. Facebook recommends 1200 x 630px

details.name: Property/ogTitle/Description
details.newValue: To overrule the title property for social sharing

details.name: Property/twitterDescription/Description
details.newValue: Optional override for twitter card description. If you do not fill in this field, Twitter will use the Open Graph tag.

details.name: Property/twitterImage/Description
details.newValue: Optional override for image card title. If you do not fill in this field, Twitter will use the Open Graph tag.

details.name: Property/twitterTitle/Description
details.newValue: Optional override for twitter card title. If you do not fill in this field, Twitter will use the Open Graph tag.

details.name: Property/disableSocialShare/Description
details.newValue: Select the social options that you want to hide from the page

details.name: Property/sources/Description
details.newValue: Configure the various sizes and corresponding video.

details.name: Property/sources/Description
details.newValue: Configure the various sizes and corresponding urls.

details.name: Property/videoId/Description
details.newValue:
The id of the video (last part of the url).
Example: **698079307**.

details.name: Property/videoId/ValidationRegExpMessage
details.newValue: Invalid Vimeo id. Make sure you inserted only the video id and not the full url.

details.name: Property/videoId/Description
details.newValue:
The id of the video (last part of the url).
Example: **q31i3L8dDZc**.

details.name: Property/videoId/ValidationRegExpMessage
details.newValue: Invalid Youtube id. Make sure you inserted only the video id and not the full url.
